Usage: yantra template [options] [command]

Create, validate, save, inspect, and remove report templates.

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  new [options] <name>           Create a starter template covering every slot
                                 kind.
  lint [options] <name-or-path>  Parse a saved template or Markdown path and
                                 print its slot manifest.
  save [options] <path>          Validate and save a Markdown template in the
                                 local library.
  list [options]                 List valid saved report templates.
  show [options] <name>          Print a saved template and its parsed slots.
  remove [options] <name>        Delete a saved report template.
  help [command]                 display help for command
